Le compresseur multibande optique : quat: The optical multiband compressor: four bands, a vocal held in place without ever pumping.
ONIRIQUE MULTI-B coupe ton son en quatre: ONIRIQUE MULTI-B splits your sound into four bands, LOW, LO-MID, HI-MID and HIGH, and compresses each one on its own with an optical cell: soft, creamy, no edges, no pumping. Boomy lows calm down without touching the highs, harsh presence is held without dulling the air, and the vocal stays even from the start to the end of the phrase.
Tout se règle dans l'écran : tu glisses: Everything is set in the display: drag the crossovers, move each band's threshold up or down, and watch its reduction drop like a curtain, with its value in large type. Per band, THRESHOLD, GAIN and SOLO to hear it alone; for all of them, ATTACK, RELEASE and OUTPUT. Without compression, the four bands sum back without colouring anything.
En bas, le MIX mélange le son direct au: At the bottom, MIX blends the dry sound with the compressed one for parallel compression, perfectly in phase, and OVERSAMPLING goes up to 8x. 11 factory presets (vocals, drums, bass, bus), A / B / C, Windows and Mac (VST3 and AU).
